fields.name: Bhakti Bibudha Bodhāyana Mahārāja
fields.aka: Bibudha bodhayan, Bibudha Bodhāyana, Asīm Dās (birth name), Acyutānanda Dās (brahmacārī name)
fields.appearance: 21 August 1964, at Kanpur (West Bengal) (the record's text)
fields.place: Born at Kanpur (West Bengal); Śrī Gopīnātha Gauḍīya Maṭha; Cakra-tīrtha (Purī); Vṛndāvana
fields.guru: Bhakti Pramoda Purī Gosvāmī Ṭhākura (Nṛsiṁha mantra, harināma 1986, sannyāsa 1993)
fields.works: Lectures and articles: Śrī Guru-pāda-padmera Praśasti and Śrī Guru-caritāmṛta (on his guru), Does taking a śikṣā guru mean rejecting one's dīkṣā guru?, Pretentious devotion, The real guru and the real śiṣya and others; the journal Bhāgavata-dharma
fields.notes: Born Asīm Dās (1964); his grandfather Madana-mohana Dās Adhikārī was a disciple of Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī. Harināma 1986 (Acyutānanda Dās), joined the Gopīnātha Gauḍīya Maṭha in 1990, sannyāsa on Gaura-pūrṇimā 1993; named by Bhakti Pramoda Purī Gosvāmī his successor in 1997, president and ācārya of the maṭha since his guru's departure (1999).

fields.name: Bhaktiratna Sādhu Mahārāja
fields.place: Born at Ahmedabad (Gujarat); Mumbai (Matunga; IIT Powai; the BBT)
fields.guru: Bhaktiśāstrī Parampada Prabhu (dīkṣā); Bhakti Kumuda Santa Gosvāmī (sannyāsa, at Behala); A. C. Bhaktivedānta Svāmī Prabhupāda (śikṣā)
fields.works: Caitanya-bhāgavata (English), Caitanya-caritāmṛta (condensed), Mahā-mantra Yoga, Our Eternal Home — Navadvīpa, The Top 100 Names of God
fields.notes: Born 22 November 1971 at Ahmedabad; found Śrīla Prabhupāda's Caitanya-caritāmṛta at IIT Powai; book distributor and BBT production manager in ISKCON; sannyāsa from Bhakti Kumuda Santa Mahārāja; preaches the names Nityānanda and Gaurāṅga with the mahā-mantra (title Gaurāṅgapada) and publishes books through the Gaurāṅga Book Fund.

fields.name: Bhakti Bhāvana Viṣṇu Mahārāja
fields.aka: Bhakti Bhavān Viṣṇu, B. B. Viṣṇu Mahārāja, Bhavānanda Rāya dāsa
fields.place: Los Angeles; Chicago; Vṛndāvana (Rūpānuga Bhajana Āśrama); Śrī Narasiṁha Caitanya Maṭha, Mysore (Śrīraṅgapatna)
fields.guru: A. C. Bhaktivedānta Svāmī Prabhupāda (harināma, 1975); B. G. Narasiṁha Mahārāja (sannyāsa, 1986); Bhakti Rakṣaka Śrīdhara Deva Gosvāmī (name and title, 1988)
fields.notes: An American physicist (Clarkson College, 1970); met Śrīla Prabhupāda in Los Angeles in 1975 (Bhavānanda Rāya dāsa); book distributor and preacher; with B. G. Narasiṁha Mahārāja the Museum of Vedic Culture (1982-87); sannyāsa 1986; name Bhakti Bhāvana Viṣṇu from Śrīdhara Mahārāja (1988); Rūpānuga Bhajana Āśrama and the Narasiṁha Caitanya Maṭha in Mysore.
